last_episode_to_air.overview: The team frames a drug dealer for murder. Candice and Antoine question him for hours. The news of Commander Renoir's departure for Montpellier has spread and everyone wants to attend.

name: Candice Renoir
overview:
Candice Renoir had put her career on standby for 10 years. When she  returns from Singapore to resume service in a port town in the south of  France, she feels a bit “rusty”. Despite the obvious defiance of her  unit and a cynical superior who doesn’t make her job any easier, she is  determined to turn her so-called weaknesses into strengths, solving the  most complex cases with her common sense, her acute observation and her  practical nature seasoned by a busy daily routine.

Only Candice can  catch a killer because she knows the chemical composition of a  window-cleaning product or determine the hour of a murder from the  cooking-time of kebabs… Candice is only naive on the outside, and nobody  can resist her!

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: After 10 years abroad, Candice Renoir is back in the south of France and back on the case as a police superintendent. Newly divorced with four kids, Candice feels rusty at work—and her skeptical colleagues dont help. Determined to prove her so-called weaknesses are strengths, she solves complex cases with common sense, acute observations, and a practical nature honed by the life of a busy mom.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Police commandant and divorced mother of four Candice Renoir continues to prove that her life experience and parental know-how are unexpected assets to crime solving.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: In Series 3 of this witty French drama, police commandant Candice Renoir continues to rely more on her school-of-life methods than on anything in the police handbook.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Chief Inspector Candice Renoir has her investigative methods ridiculed in court; loses her deputy, Antoine Dumas and finds her mother implicated in a string of murders.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: After her lover is tragically killed, Candice Renoir is eager to get right back to work But has she returned too soon and is she up to the job? Does she still believe in love? Where will the mutual attraction between Inspector Renoir and Captain Dumas lead? If she can also deal with the challenges of raising her four kids, Candice just might find out.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Inspector Candice Renoir is as self-assured as ever as she and her unit tackle a string of challenging cases but when Antoine returns after a year away and is named the brigade's new chief, intense passion turns into fiery complications.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: Now that Candice has married Max, all seems to be well. However with a honeymoon cut short and many murders to solve, Candice's personal and professional lives are under more pressure than ever, causing her to question her future.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: Candice and Antoine's relationship is back to square one after his brain surgery impairs his memory. While the team works to catch killers in the south of France, the past begins to catch up with them as old secrets and new traumas come to the fore.

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: Candice is put on administrative duties for failing to report Antoine's amnesia while hotshot detective Penelope Vallier takes over the investigations. Candice is determined to get back to working cases and leading her team.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: After surviving being shot, Candice returns with a fierce determination to embrace life, her femininity and her love for Antoine as she continues to solve cases and turn her perceived weaknesses into strengths.
